senses.sense_definition: A type of edible marine bivalve shellfish with a dark, elongated shell, often farmed or gathered for food.

examples.text: We ordered a big bowl of steamed <w>mussels</w> in white wine sauce at the seaside restaurant.
The coastal rocks were completely covered with small black <w>mussels</w>.

senses.sense_definition: Any of various bivalve mollusks that live in freshwater environments such as rivers and lakes.

examples.text: The native freshwater <w>mussel</w> is threatened by river pollution and habitat loss.
Biologists found a rare species of <w>mussel</w> living in the clear waters of the creek.

senses.sense_definition: Any of certain other similar bivalve mollusks, such as invasive zebra or quagga mussels.

examples.text: The zebra <w>mussel</w> is an invasive species that disrupts local lake ecosystems.
Boat owners must clean their vessels to avoid spreading the tiny <w>mussel</w> between waterways.
